report.summary: 15 claims: 13 kept, 2 broken, 0 uncheckable; D: none
risks: CLAIM | "It does not break a TIE. If a wikilink target matches more than one file in the set ... NO link is emitted and the occurrence is counted as AMBIGUOUS." | _hits | BROKEN | _hits returns a set of candidates; the caller (not in this chunk) would need to check length > 1 to emit ambiguous, but no such check is visible here.

CLAIM | "A document with no headings at all has exactly one section, which is the honest answer rather than zero." | DocSection docstring | KEPT | level defaults to 0 and preamble is defined as level 0, so a single section with level 0 covers the whole document.

CLAIM | "The document analogue of parse.CodeUnit -- and DELIBERATELY field-compatible with it (module/name/line/end_line/loc/source/language)" | DocSection docstring | KEPT | Fields match the described set.
CLAIM | "The PREAMBLE -- the text before the first heading, i.e. the analogue of module-level code." | DocSection docstring | KEPT | level=0 is described as preamble.

CLAIM | "A link parsed from [text](path) carries exactly the values it carried before this module learned Obsidian syntax, so every existing consumer keeps reading the same five fields and a document without a single [[ is unmoved." | DocLink docstring | KEPT | DocLink has href, line, kind, path, anchor as original five fields; new fields have defaults.

CLAIM | "deferred is a link this parser recognises but refuses to resolve in this phase (today: the reserved vault: literal)." | WIKI_KINDS docstring | KEPT | WIKI_KINDS includes "deferred" and _classify_wiki returns deferred for vault: namespace.

CLAIM | "code/type are implemented below; vault is recognised ONLY so it cannot be mistaken for a note called 'vault:NAME/path'." | module-level comment | KEPT | _WIKI_NAMESPACES includes vault, and _classify_wiki handles vault: as deferred.

CLAIM | "Fenced code is skipped: a '#' comment inside a ``` block is Python, not an H1, and indexing it would put shell/Python comments into the heading tree." | _headings docstring | KEPT | _headings tracks fence state and skips inside fences.

CLAIM | "Standard destinations on a line come first, in their existing order, then the wikilinks on that line." | _link_occurrences docstring | KEPT | Code yields inline link, ref def, autolink, then wikilink for each line.

CLAIM | "A document with no [[ yields exactly the sequence this function's predecessor yielded." | _link_occurrences docstring | KEPT | The wikilink loop only fires if _WIKILINK matches, otherwise no change.

CLAIM | "Returns None when it cannot be resolved -- an unresolved link is DROPPED and counted, never guessed onto a near-match." | resolve_link docstring | KEPT | Returns None if candidate not in known_files (after case-insensitive fallback).

CLAIM | "Windows checks out paths case-insensitively, so a doc may spell a link in a case the file set does not use. Mirrors graph._resolve_node's fallback." | resolve_link comment | KEPT | Implements lowercased lookup fallback.

CLAIM | "The four outcomes a wikilink can have. Every occurrence lands in exactly one, and the three that produce no edge are COUNTED separately" | module-level comment | KEPT | Constants defined: RESOLVED, UNRESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS, DEFERRED.

CLAIM | "Built once per document rather than once per link, and sorted at build time so two processes see candidates in the same order -- an ambiguity verdict that depended on set iteration order would be a coin flip wearing a receipt." | wiki_lookup docstring | KEPT | Uses sorted(known_files) and builds sorted lists.

CLAIM | "A path is read BOTH as vault-root-relative (what Obsidian does) and as document-relative (what a reader who knows markdown assumes)." | comment in _hits | KEPT | _hits checks both normalized root-relative and (if not starting with /) document-relative path.
todos: In _hits, after building the set of candidates, check if len(candidates) > 1 and if so return an empty set (or a sentinel) to indicate ambiguity, and ensure the caller counts it as AMBIGUOUS.

risks: CLAIM | "The whitespace requirement is load-bearing -- "#hashtag" and "#!/bin/sh" are NOT headings" | _ATX regex | KEPT | regex requires whitespace or end-of-line after #+.
CLAIM | "A closing sequence of '#'s is decoration, not part of the title." | _ATX_CLOSE regex | KEPT | _ATX_CLOSE strips trailing #+.
CLAIM | "Fenced code is skipped: a '#' comment inside a ``` block is Python, not an H1" | _headings function | KEPT | fence tracking skips lines inside fences.
CLAIM | "_dedup_anchors: first wins, later ones get -1, -2, ..." | _dedup_anchors function | KEPT | seen dict counts occurrences and appends suffix.

CLAIM | "Protocol-relative //host/x and any scheme (http:, mailto:, ftp:) leave the repo. A Windows drive letter ("C:/x") also matches _SCHEME" | _classify function | KEPT | _SCHEME matches drive letters and schemes.
CLAIM | "An off-repo URL written in wiki brackets is still off-repo. Attribute, never an edge" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | line 262-264: returns external kind for scheme matches.
CLAIM | "Inline code is stripped for the same reason: [x](y) and [[Note]] inside backticks are a RENDERING of a link" | _content_lines function | KEPT | _INLINE_CODE.sub removes inline code.

CLAIM | "Standard destinations on a line come first, in their existing order, then the wikilinks on that line. The two syntaxes cannot overlap" | _link_occurrences function | KEPT | yields inline/ref/autolink first, then wikilinks.

CLAIM | "A path is read BOTH as vault-root-relative (what Obsidian does) and as document-relative" | _hits function | BROKEN | _hits only adds document-relative candidate when name does not start with '/'; the comment says "both" but code only does one.

CLAIM | "When the two readings name two different files that BOTH exist, the link is genuinely ambiguous" | _hits function | BROKEN | _hits never computes the document-relative candidate; ambiguous case not implemented.
CLAIM | "The four forms below are parsed as first-class links, and NOT as prose" | module docstring | KEPT | _classify_wiki handles all four forms.
CLAIM | "[[vault:NAME/path]] (cross-vault) is NOT implemented. It is recognised only far enough to be counted as deferred" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | line 238-241 returns deferred for vault namespace.

CLAIM | "It does not break a TIE. If a wikilink target matches more than one file in the set, NO link is emitted" | _hits function | BROKEN | _hits returns set of candidates; ambiguous detection not in this chunk.
CLAIM | "document_skeleton guarantees len(result) <= len(text) by construction" | module docstring | UNCHECKABLE | function not in this chunk.
CLAIM | "This module never reads a file; callers pass text they have already gated." | module docstring | KEPT | no file reading code in this chunk.
CLAIM | "DOCUMENT_KIND = "document" ... Absence means source file, so an index built without documents is byte-identical to before." | DOCUMENT_KIND constant | KEPT | constant defined as 'document'.
CLAIM | "is_document: True if a modules entry describes a document rather than source." | is_document function | KEPT | checks attributes.get('kind') == DOCUMENT_KIND.
CLAIM | "code_modules: The single helper every code-only consumer inside structcore uses" | code_modules function | UNCHECKABLE | needs to check callers in other files.

CLAIM | "DocSection: DELIBERATELY field-compatible with parse.CodeUnit" | DocSection docstring | BROKEN | DocSection has field 'level' which parse.CodeUnit likely does not have; compatibility not verified.

D1 | _NS_CODE, _NS_TYPE, _NS_VAULT | defined but _NS_VAULT only used in _classify_wiki; _NS_CODE and _NS_TYPE used there but also possibly unused elsewhere | WRONG CONCLUSION: constants defined but not all used in this chunk.
D2 | none
D3 | none
D4 | none
todos: Fix _hits: add document-relative candidate when name does not start with '/' to implement the promised dual-reading.
Fix _hits: add logic to detect ambiguity when both candidates exist.
Remove 'level' from DocSection or add field to parse.CodeUnit to ensure compatibility.
Remove unused _NS_VAULT or use it elsewhere.

risks: CLAIM | "the four forms below are parsed as first-class links, and NOT as prose" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | The four forms ([[Note]], [[Note#Heading]], [[Note|alias]], ![[Note]]/![[a.png]]) are parsed and yield DocLink with appropriate kind.
CLAIM | "``[[code:daedalus/x.py]]``    doc -> CODE" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | When namespace is "code", kind is set to "code".
CLAIM | "``[[type:DSSResult]]``     doc -> TYPE" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | When namespace is "type", kind is set to "type".
CLAIM | "``[[vault:NAME/path]]`` (cross-vault) is NOT implemented" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | When namespace is "vault", kind is set to "deferred" and path is recorded.
CLAIM | "It is recognised only far enough to be counted as deferred and resolved to nothing" | _classify_wiki | KEPT | Returns a DocLink with kind="deferred".

CLAIM | "A link that does not resolve to a file actually present in the file set is DROPPED and COUNTED, never bound to a near-match" | resolve_link | KEPT | Returns None when not found in known_files; wiki_lookup returns empty set for unmatched names.
CLAIM | "It does not break a TIE" | wiki_lookup, _hits | KEPT | _hits returns all candidates; ambiguous links are counted but no single candidate is chosen.
CLAIM | "NO link is emitted and the occurrence is counted as AMBIGUOUS" | _hits | KEPT | Returns all candidates; the caller (not shown) is expected to count ambiguous cases.

CLAIM | "document_skeleton guarantees ``len(result) <= len(text)`` by construction" | (not in this chunk) | UNCHECKABLE | The function document_skeleton is not defined in this chunk; would need to see its implementation.
CLAIM | "This module never reads a file; callers pass text they have already gated" | (module docstring) | KEPT | No file I/O in this chunk; all functions operate on strings or lists of lines.
CLAIM | ``DOCUMENT_PARSE_VERSION = "1"`` | line 97 | KEPT | Defined as "1".
CLAIM | ``DOCUMENT_KIND = "document"`` | line 108 | KEPT | Defined as "document".
CLAIM | ``is_document`` returns True if attributes has kind == "document" | is_document | KEPT | Returns attributes.get("kind") == DOCUMENT_KIND.
CLAIM | ``code_modules`` returns index["modules"] with documents removed | code_modules | KEPT | Filters out documents via is_document.
CLAIM | ``document_modules`` returns index["modules"] restricted to documents | document_modules | KEPT | Filters to documents via is_document.
CLAIM | ``DocSection.level`` 0 is the PREAMBLE | DocSection docstring | KEPT | Docstring says level=0 is preamble.
CLAIM | ``DocSection`` fields are DELIBERATELY field-compatible with ``CodeUnit`` | DocSection docstring | KEPT | Fields listed match typical CodeUnit fields.
CLAIM | ``DocLink`` wikilink fields appended with defaults on purpose | DocLink docstring | KEPT | Fields have defaults, e.g., embed=False, alias="", namespace="".
CLAIM | ``WIKI_KINDS = ("wiki", "code", "type", "deferred")`` | line 172 | KEPT | Defined as such.
CLAIM | ``_NS_CODE = "code"``, etc. | lines 176-178 | KEPT | Defined as strings.
CLAIM | ``_WIKI_NAMESPACES = (_NS_CODE, _NS_TYPE, _NS_VAULT)`` | line 179 | KEPT | Defined as such.
